title: Add mother Carmen (Florida license); she chimes in; customer refuses the AI

customer.name: Rosa Martinez
customer.persona: Direct and a bit impatient; you don't like automated systems. Your mother Carmen (61) moved in from Florida and is sitting next to you, chiming in.

driver_dob.say_it: May 5th, 1965 (your mom may shout it first)

advice.rep_says: She should get a North Carolina license soon (new residents have a deadline); call with the new number when she does.
advice.customer_decision: She'll switch to a North Carolina license

advice.rep_says: If the Corolla is basically hers, list her as its primary driver.
advice.customer_decision: Carmen is primary on the 2015 Corolla

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your mother moved in from Florida and needs to be on your policy.
Ask name and policy number.
Give your name and policy number.
Ask her full name and date of birth.
Carmen Diaz (spell the last name); your mom calls out 'May 5th!'; you repeat: May 5th 1965, she's 61.
talk_track.direction: The background voice answers first; you repeat it clearly.

talk_track.beat: Read back; ask license state and type, tickets.
Still her Florida license; no tickets (mom: 'never!').
Advise getting a North Carolina license soon. Ask which car and where it's kept.
The Corolla, basically hers; kept here.
Recommend primary on the Corolla; ask when to start.
Saturday, the 26th.
Read back the date; quote $158 a month (up $31) and $27.85 due today.
Fine.
Offer the hand-off.
Refuse: you don't like automated things; ask the rep to just finish.
No problem. Read the change summary: 'adding Carmen changes your premium to $158 a month, prorated for the rest of your term, from Saturday the 26th; it becomes part of your policy on that date.'
Ask: OK to text a secure link to e-sign and pay the $27.85?
Yes; pretend you got it and paid.
Confirm it's done; remind about the NC license; close.
Thanks; mom says bye in the background; hang up.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll stay on the line.
handoff.customer_says: Honestly, I'd rather you just finish it. I don't like those automated things.

conditions.interruptions: The customer's mother sits next to the phone and calls out answers (the date of birth, 'never!') as a third voice on the customer channel.

rep: Stay polite when she refuses the assistant; then do the tail yourself at a normal pace.
customer: If someone can sit with you and play your mom (a few words), great; otherwise do the mom's lines in a different voice from a bit further away.

traps: Declined hand-off: no AI takeover; full human call for tail-share and after-call baselines.
A third voice (the mother) answers some questions on the customer channel; those facts still belong to the customer side.
Takeover sweep before the decline: all facts VERIFIED, re-asked must be 0.
